articles.title: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Posts Blowout Q2 Earnings, Joins Marvell Technology And Other Big Stocks Moving Higher In Tuesday's Session
articles.teaser: US stock futures surge on tech sector news, HPE reports strong earnings, and other tech stocks follow suit in pre-market trading.
articles.body:
U.S. stock futures were sharply higher this morning, with the Nasdaq futures surging nearly 0.50% on Tuesday following spectacular quarterly financial results and high-profile tech sector partnership announcements.

Shares of Hewlett Packard Enterprise Co (NYSE:HPE) skyrocketed in pre-market trading after delivering a historic fiscal second-quarter earnings report that crushed Wall Street forecasts.

HPE reported quarterly non-GAAP diluted earnings of $0.79 per share, soundly beating the consensus analyst estimate of $0.54 per share. Total net revenue reached $10.7 billion. The growth was fueled by an unprecedented influx of enterprise orders for AI inference servers and networking equipment. Management aggressively raised its fiscal 2026 full-year non-GAAP EPS guidance to a range of $3.35 to $3.45 and boosted its free cash flow target to at least $3.5 billion, indicating structural data center modernization is moving ahead of schedule.

HPE shares jumped 26.49% to $59.45 in pre-market trading.

Here are some other stocks moving higher in pre-market trading:

  • Marvell Technology Inc (NASDAQ:MRVL) shares soared 22.19% to $268.14 in pre-market trading after Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang explicitly labeled the chipmaker as the “next trillion-dollar company” during a joint keynote address at the Computex event in Taipei.
  • Kelly Services Inc Class A (NASDAQ:KELYB) climbed 11.85% to $23.49 in pre-market trading.
  • POET Technologies Inc (NASDAQ:POET) rose 11.37% to $15.47 in pre-market trading, catching direct tech tailwinds as demand for high-speed optical interlinks scales alongside massive data center hardware buildouts.
  • STMicroelectronics NV (NYSE:STM) advanced 11.18% to $76.74 in pre-market trading.
  • Relmada Therapeutics Inc (NASDAQ:RLMD) gained 10.94% to $7.60 in pre-market trading on steady, speculative clinical-stage clinical program reassessments.
  • Lithium Americas Corp (NYSE:LAC) added 10.52% to $6.09 in pre-market trading, rebounding on localized domestic battery infrastructure funding headlines and broader rare metals asset flows.
  • Polibeli Group Ltd (NASDAQ:PLBL) ticked up 10.21% to $6.80 in pre-market trading.
  • Camtek Ltd (NASDAQ:CAMT) rose 10.12% to $179.61 in pre-market trading, benefiting heavily from increased capital expenditure projections across top-tier semiconductor packaging lines.
  • Hesai Group – ADR (NASDAQ:HSAI) advanced 9.83% to $22.00 in pre-market trading.
  • Generac Holdings Inc (NYSE:GNRC) ticked up 9.26% to $294.20 in pre-market trading.
  • Lightwave Logic Inc (NASDAQ:LWLG) rose 8.89% to $12.00 in pre-market trading.
